newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Tech stock options highlight.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Tech stock options highlight.

text.p: Technology stock options highlighted trading Friday as several issues were knocked for heavy losses.
The most active options included Cisco Systems Inc, Atmel Corp t Intel Corp and Microchip Technology Inc.
Cisco shares were off 3-3/8 at 51-1/4 on volume of more than 21 million shares in late trading after Furman Selz lowered some earnings estimates.
Options trading in Cisco was led by the March 55 call, which traded about 5,070 contracts. The option, which had open interest of 4,767, fell 1-3/16 to 1-1/8.
The Cisco March 60 call traded about 3,050 contracts and the April 60 call traded nearly 2,100.
Among the puts, the Cisco March 55 was most active, with turnover of 3,450 contracts.
Atmel slumped five to 26-1/2 on about 13.5 million shares after it said its inability to get products to market quickly enough would hold back its fiscal first quarter results.
The heaviest Atmel options activity was in the April series, where the 27-1/2-strike call traded about 3,555 contracts. The April 30 call traded 1,760 contracts and the April 27-1/2 put traded 1,725.
Trading in other Atmel options was steady, but no others had crossed more than 1,000 contracts.
Microchip Technology fell in sympathy with Atmel, losing 6-1/16 to 29-1/2. Turnover topped 10 million shares.
Among Microchip options, the March 35 put traded nearly 4,000 contracts, putting it among the most active puts overall at Chicago Board Options Exchange.
The option, which had open interest of 129 contracts going into Friday, gained 2-3/4 to 4-3/4.
The Microchip March 30 call, with open interest of just 13 contracts, traded about 1,160 contracts. It fell 3-7/8 to 1-5/8.
In other options activity, traders said Humana Inc options drew slightly more interest than normal after a report the company was a takeover target.
"There's a little bit more (volume) than normal," one options trader said, adding that most of the increased action was from investors buying the March 20 calls.
That option had volume of about 435 contracts in late trade. Its open interest, including an addition of 20 contracts Thursday, was 905.
With the stock climbing 1-5/8 to 22-1/2, the March 20 call gained 1-1/4 to 2-5/8.
One options strategist called the overall Humana volume "nothing spectacular." Volatilities rose modestly.

The Humana May 20 call, which traded nearly 200 contracts Friday, had the highest open interest among all the calls, with 1,171 through Thursday, when 51 contracts were added. ((--G.Crawford, 312 408 8750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
